name: Hundred Finance hWBTC exchange-rate inflation
summary: The Compound-v2 fork derived hWBTC's exchange rate from its raw WBTC balance and rounded redeemUnderlying share amounts down. In the nearly empty market, the attacker retained two wei of hWBTC, donated WBTC to inflate their collateral value, borrowed every other Optimism market, then redeemed the donation while the inflated collateral position remained.
notes: The hWBTC delegator selected the defect-bearing implementation during construction; its implementation slot remained unchanged through the exploit.
The $7.4 million gross loss is the published campaign total for the two Optimism attack transactions. Hundred Finance separately described the theft as approximately $7 million.
The $7.4 million gross campaign value is a rounded published estimate rather than a per-asset incident-time valuation.
